n: The actual skin doesn't have the title bar. It is based on my RPG, "The Crystal", which is currently in development. KSNiloc also made a skin for my game. You can get it on the downloads page of my site, http://markofdragon.mysticsoftware.net .

The native peoples of North America gave us the tradition of the dreamcatcher, a hoop of twigs woven with an intricate web of sinew. It is believed that good dreams, floating in the night air, pass through the hanging web and flow down the dangling feathers to the sleeper below. But nightmares are caught in the web and held until they perish in the first light of day.

Warner Bros. Pictures contracted The Skins Factory to bring the Dreamcatcher to your desktop this winter in the form of a Windows Media Player 9 Series skin.

Includes a full compliment of audio enhancement features and new sound events including a narrator’s voiceover when you view the Dreamcatcher’s iMode window.
Hint 1: Click the Dreamcatcher logo on the display screen.
Hint 2: You can turn his voice off with the mute button on the iMode, but you will have to relaunch the window to hear it again.

So if you have your computer in the bedroom, make sure you have your Dreamcatcher skin up and running and who knows… maybe it will catch a nightmare. Now if it could only catch spam…

Coming to Theatres March 21.

t: Windows XP Media Center Edition Enhanced (WMP9-XP)
n:
Enhanced for Users of Windows Media Player 9 Series and Windows XP

Fully revolving shutter/display and a variant color preset so you can invert the skin’s colors. Also contains resizable Playlist, Video and Visualization modes. The informative “iMode” explains the power and functionality of the Windows XP Media Center Edition. Includes Sound events not found in our other version. This version is strictly for XP Users, while our other version is for Win 98/ME/2K/XP.

Enjoy.

Ok, heres an interesting skin. It seems I will make a skin our of anything. Anyways, as you can see by the preview, this one has a playlist but no video or equalizer. Its good for just listening to tunes since its a fairly discrete player. Hope you like it. I will now accept some requests for skins, so send me an email if you have a good idea. Thanx much.
